title: Matrix column extraction
summary: Recovered VA 0x426fa0 as a thiscall member returning the output pointer. Copies raw words at offsets column*4, column*4+16 and column*4+32, with ordered overlapping accesses and output fourth word zeroed first. Direct Game.exe disassembly agrees with accepted assembly. Call sites at 0x4d4e80 and following use columns 0, 1 and 2; neighboring copy routine establishes a 64-byte matrix representation.
test_description: Direct original thiscall comparison for 16 rotations of signed zeros, infinities, signaling/quiet NaNs, subnormals and arbitrary words; indices 0..7 with valid in-object reads; separate guarded output and all 13 overlapping output spans. Compare return pointers, complete matrix and guard/output storage, exact bits and unchanged MXCSR under two control modes.
known_limits: Original source type names and precise declared return type are unresolved; pointer return is established by callers and EAX.
Invalid pointers and indices outside valid backing storage are not tested; original has no bounds checks. Portable implementation requires valid uint32_t storage and non-overflowing index arithmetic.
No byte matching claim; Windows native compilation is left to trusted validation.
